name: Kyonyuu Juu ~Datenshijima Injuu Geboku Senki~
original_name: 巨乳獣～堕天使島 淫獣下僕戦記～
source:
This is Varapu Island located in the south of the Highlandi Republic. It's also called “Fallen Angel Island” for the number of phantom beasts witnessed there for the last hundred years.
A strange colorful four people party arrives to this island to investigate phantom beast ruins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这里是位于海兰迪共和国南方的瓦拉普岛。过去百年间，岛上频繁有人目击堕天使系幻兽，因此这里又被称为“堕天使岛”。
一支成员个性鲜明、构成奇特的四人队伍来到岛上，调查幻兽遗迹。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
